name: takeWhile_predecessor_losses_iff
statement:
theorem takeWhile_predecessor_losses_iff
    {H : LabelledQuotient} {y : Fin H.vertexCount}
    (chain : List (CutPair H))
    (nested : chain.Pairwise
      (fun ancestor child => ∀ p, child.Mem p → H.Lost ancestor p))
    (passes : CutPair H → Bool)
    (correct : ∀ B, passes B = true ↔ ∀ u, H.HasQuotientArc u y → H.Lost B u)
    (B : CutPair H) :
    B ∈ chain.takeWhile passes ↔
      B ∈ chain ∧ ∀ u, H.HasQuotientArc u y → H.Lost B u
hint: Induct on chain. Split on passes head. If head passes, use List.takeWhile_cons_of_pos, List.pairwise_cons.mp and the induction hypothesis. If it fails, no later cut can pass: lost_of_nested_endpoints maps the later cut's losses to the head by the supplied nesting. List.takeWhile_cons_of_neg makes the prefix empty. The existing predecessor_losses_form_prefix is relevant, but this goal connects the property to the actual executable takeWhile. Use plain Lean core tactics.

name: sweep_parent_eq_for_reused_pair_key
statement:
theorem sweep_parent_eq_for_reused_pair_key
    {H : LabelledQuotient} {P : CutPair H}
    {rank : Fin H.vertexCount → Nat}
    (distinctRanks : ∀ a b, rank a = rank b → a = b)
    (ancestors : Fin H.vertexCount → List (CutPair H))
    {y z mY mZ : Fin H.vertexCount}
    (keyY : ∀ u, H.HasQuotientArc u y ↔ P.Mem u)
    (keyZ : ∀ u, H.HasQuotientArc u z ↔ P.Mem u)
    (edgeY : H.HasQuotientArc mY y) (edgeZ : H.HasQuotientArc mZ z)
    (latestY : ∀ u, H.HasQuotientArc u y → rank u ≤ rank mY)
    (latestZ : ∀ u, H.HasQuotientArc u z → rank u ≤ rank mZ)
    (passesY passesZ : CutPair H → Bool)
    (correctY : ∀ B, passesY B = true ↔ ∀ u, H.HasQuotientArc u y → H.Lost B u)
    (correctZ : ∀ B, passesZ B = true ↔ ∀ u, H.HasQuotientArc u z → H.Lost B u) :
    ((ancestors mY).takeWhile passesY).getLast? =
      ((ancestors mZ).takeWhile passesZ).getLast?
hint: Identical cut key P means identical predecessor sets for y and z. Thus the two latest predecessors have equal ranks by latestY/latestZ and Nat.le_antisymm, so they are the same vertex by distinctRanks. For each B, transport the predecessor condition between y and z using keyY and keyZ. Prove the Bool tests are equal, e.g. splitting on both Booleans then funext. Rewrite the resulting equalities. The ancestors function is a single immutable map of earlier labels. None is the artificial root.

name: sweep_step_preserves_proper_loss_labels
statement:
theorem sweep_step_preserves_proper_loss_labels
    {H : LabelledQuotient} {rank : Fin H.vertexCount → Nat}
    (rankArc : ∀ u v, H.HasQuotientArc u v → rank u < rank v)
    (flat : H.IsFlat) {m y : Fin H.vertexCount}
    (notRoot : H.root ≠ y) (entering : H.HasQuotientArc m y)
    (latest : ∀ u, H.HasQuotientArc u y → rank u ≤ rank m)
    (chain : List (CutPair H))
    (nested : chain.Pairwise
      (fun ancestor child => ∀ p, child.Mem p → H.Lost ancestor p))
    (priorSound : ∀ B, B ∈ chain → H.ProperLoss B m)
    (priorComplete : ∀ B : CutPair H, B.fst < B.snd → H.ProperLoss B m → B ∈ chain)
    (passes : CutPair H → Bool)
    (correct : ∀ B, passes B = true ↔ ∀ u, H.HasQuotientArc u y → H.Lost B u)
    (candidate : Option (CutPair H))
    (candidateExact : ∀ B : CutPair H, candidate = some B ↔
      B.fst < B.snd ∧ ∀ u, H.HasQuotientArc u y ↔ B.Mem u) :
    let next := chain.takeWhile passes ++ candidate.toList
    next.Pairwise (fun ancestor child => ∀ p, child.Mem p → H.Lost ancestor p) ∧
      ∀ B : CutPair H, B.fst < B.snd → (B ∈ next ↔ H.ProperLoss B y)
hint: This is the induction transition with the already-processed ancestor list for m and an optional canonical two-predecessor key. Use previous takeWhile_predecessor_losses_iff chain nested passes correct to characterize members of the selected prefix. For nesting use List.pairwise_append, List.takeWhile_sublist and nested.sublist; candidate.toList is empty/singleton. For the cross property B in the prefix loses all predecessors of y, and every endpoint of the candidate is a predecessor by candidateExact. Option.mem_toList turns membership into candidate = some key. For membership correctness use List.mem_append. A prefix member properly loses m by priorSound, so omits m; apply properLoss_iff_of_latest_predecessor_not_mem rankArc flat notRoot entering. The optional key contains m since it has exactly the predecessors as endpoints, so apply properLoss_iff_predecessors_are_endpoints_of_latest_mem rankArc flat notRoot entering latest. Conversely split on B.Mem m; the two existing lemmas put B in the candidate or the prefix, respectively. Use exact argument order. Canonical cut-pair order is by Fin identifiers.
